prior_context.source_quote:
Spy update.

This is going to be the last chance I can see for the bulls to make a comeback. We see bearish confirmations across the board, but SPY is holding onto a RSI divergence below the 68% weekly expected move. The SPX500 futures are showing the 4 HR divergence on both the MACD and RSI. If these are violated with another roll, then the bulls have a VERY LOW probability to recover. This is because another roll that ruins these signals would imply at at least 2 waves further down.
Important to trade like water, and that means always considering decision making at the weekly expected move! Bulls better show up because when I said they have til the end of this week, I meant it. Bulls need to recover with these signals now, or we are looking at more downside.
@everyone

As mentioned yesterday, it looks like they are wanting to run SPY into 765 ATM.
I am seeing a lot of Vanna stacked at the 740 range for Friday.
765 is also our daily upper em given yesterday.

For the moment bulls are in control. I am biased bullish prior to the meeting. If we reach 765 I am going to buy 0DTE puts and hedge them with 774 calls for Friday.

This plan is subject to change @here

SPY SWINGS 200% and going ITM
Taking 70% @everyone

$SPY
Quiet open expected after a soft week driven by rising yields.
Price holding the mid-760s after the Aug 13 peak at 779. Key zone: 762–765 support. Hold and we look higher. Lose 762 with volume and the next shelf sits near 755–758.
@everyone

SPY Trade Ideas 💡
🟢 CALL: Above 770 → 772, 773
🔴 PUT: Below 769 → 768, 765

Trade safe and manage your risk! 📈📉 @everyone
